name: Fourth Uncle
intro: Wang Lin's uncle, once thrown out of the clan, who wins him a place at the Heng Yue trial.

name: Huang Long
intro: Sect master of the Heng Yue Sect, who tests the Wang children; he burns his lifespan against Pu Nanzi.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Heng Yue sect master at the recruitment.

name: Situ Nan
intro: The strongest man of the Vermilion Bird country, revealed as the second Suzaku, whose soul has lived in the Heaven Defying Bead for ages and teaches Wang Lin. After a long sleep he wakes, takes a new body and travels with Wang Lin again.

power.detail: the second Suzaku; his body is destroyed holding the Heaven Defying Bead
wakes in the Forsaken Ascendant's demon-child body he seized in EP96

looks.label: Prologue
looks.desc: Powerful cultivator of the prologue, destroyed holding the bead.

looks.label: Soul in the bead
looks.desc: His soul in the bead's dream space.

looks.label: New body
looks.desc: The young demon body he seized in EP96.

arc.text: Holds the Heaven Defying Bead against outside experts and is destroyed, vowing to return.
Meets Wang Lin inside the bead and teaches him.
Wang Lin promises him freedom once he reaches Soul Transformation.
Wakes, drives off Zhu Quezi, gives Wang Lin the bead and takes a Forsaken Ascendant's body.
Teaches Wang Lin the Annihilation, Demon Transformation and Yellow Springs Fingers.

name: Wang Hao
intro: Wang Lin's cousin, who passes the Heng Yue spiritual root test and is taken on as an alchemy helper.

name: Wang Lin
intro: A poor village boy of the Country of Zhao, chosen by the Heaven Defying Bead, who turns into a ruthless cultivator after the Teng clan wipes out his family. Through EP160 he lives under many names (Ma Liang, Zeng Niu, Qing Mu, Xu Mu), works with a clone and an Ancient God body, and keeps searching for a way to revive Li Muwan.

power.detail: a wood carver's son with poor spiritual roots
barely reached after long practice inside the bead
the centipede's venom burns out Sun Dazhu's poison
fifteenth level, the same as Bai Zhan
breaks a bottleneck into the Extreme Realm, which caps him at Nascent Soul
a year after taking Ma Liang's body (an EP12 caption calling him late stage seems to read Ma Liang's body)
forms a real core after the false core of EP18
a false Nascent Soul; the Extreme Realm blocks his own breakthrough. In EP39-42 his clone climbs from level 3 Qi Condensation to early Core Formation in the Cloud Sky Sect
through the clone; his own breakthrough failed
the body living as a mortal in Nan is his clone
peak of late Nascent Soul, still living as a mortal
clone, with the Life and Death Intent Realm; his original body sheds the Extreme Realm, drops to Foundation Establishment and becomes a Two-Star Ancient God
his Life and Death domain reaches mid Soul Formation level
clone; in EP80 the main body becomes a true Ancient God with a Reincarnation Fruit

falls back to early after the duel with Hongdie; in EP83-86 Li Yuanfeng's tea scar and Sun Tai's seal drain him to level 3 Qi Condensation and he climbs back through Foundation Establishment and Nascent Soul
clone back at Soul Formation in the Soul Refining Sect
clone, lifted by Dun Tian's gifts; the real body is a Three-Star Ancient God
completes the three steps under Dun Tian's guard
peak of mid stage, per Situ Nan
clone in the Demon Spirit Land, from one drop of immortal wine
called peak Soul Transformation before the drum
clone, by reverse cultivation through Heaven's Wrath with Bei Lou's help; stabilised in EP124
avatar; his Life and Death domain is at Ascendant great perfection. As Xu Mu he passes for late Core Formation
avatar, now in a lightning body forged over sixty years
avatar, reached during the year between EP151 and EP152

looks.label: Village boy
looks.desc: Poor teenage wood carver's son from a Zhao village.

looks.label: In Ma Liang's body
looks.desc: Wears the face and body of the War Shrine Sect disciple Ma Liang.
looks.why: his own body is destroyed in the Soul Flag fight (EP11)

looks.label: Own body, Ancient God
looks.desc: Back in his own body, reshaped by the Ancient God's power; his own face again.

arc.text: Fails the Heng Yue Sect's spiritual root test but climbs the trial ladder anyway.
Finds the Heaven Defying Bead, home of Situ Nan's soul, and starts to cultivate.
Teng Huayuan kills his parents and the Wang clan; their souls are sealed in a Soul Flag.
Loses his body and takes over Ma Liang's on the foreign battlefield.
Becomes leader of the Fighting Evil Sect in the Sea of Devils and parts from Li Muwan.
Named the fourth Enlightened One by Tu Si in the Land of the Ancient God.
Kills Teng Huayuan and wipes out the Teng family.
Li Muwan's life runs out; he keeps her Nascent Soul and later places it in the newborn Zhou Ru.
Reaches Soul Transformation on Planet Suzaku and inherits the Billion Soul Flag from Dun Tian.
Joins All-Seer's Heavenly Fate Sect on Planet Tianyun as the seventh Purple disciple.
His clone reaches Ascendant in the Demon Spirit Land through Heaven's Wrath.
Adopts Li'er as his son Wang Ping on Planet Ran Yun, then loses him in EP142.
Reaches Corporeal Yang in the Thunder Celestial Realm, travelling as Xu Mu with Li Yuan.

name: Wang Tianshui
intro: Wang Lin's father, a poor wood carver. Teng Huayuan kills him and seals his soul in the Soul Flag.

name: Wang Zhuo
intro: Wang Lin's talented, arrogant cousin who joins the Xuan Dao Sect. Forced by the Teng family to marry Teng Xiu Xiu, he kills her and himself, is reborn, and becomes a Xuan Dao elder whom Wang Lin helps into Nascent Soul.

power.detail: breaks through with Wang Lin's help, from late Core Formation

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Proud young cousin chosen by the sect.

looks.label: Reincarnation
looks.desc: Reborn into a new Wang household after his death in EP49.

name: Zhou Yingsu
intro: Wang Lin's mother, named only on her memorial tablet. Teng Huayuan kills her with her husband and seals her soul in the Soul Flag.

name: Sun Dazhu
intro: Heng Yue elder who takes Wang Lin as a disciple only to poison and rob him; Wang Lin kills him.

name: Zhang Hu
intro: Wang Lin's first friend at Heng Yue. He kills Liu Shulang, flees and ends up among Bai Zhan's bandits; Wang Lin remembers him for centuries.

name: Zhang Kuang
intro: Senior Heng Yue disciple who escorts Wang Lin into the sect. Centuries later the Tian Dao Sect has captured him and drained his cultivation.

power.detail: drained from Core Formation by the Tian Dao Sect

name: Li Muwan
intro: An alchemist of the Luohe Sect whom Wang Lin saves and takes into the Sea of Devils, where they fall in love; later an elder of the Cloud Sky Sect. When her life runs out Wang Lin keeps her Nascent Soul and looks for a way to bring her back.

power.detail: forms it after Wang Lin's pill, but her lifespan is gone

arc.text: Named at last; Wang Lin saves her, and in EP18 takes her into the Sea of Devils to refine pills.
Parts from Wang Lin after four years, leaving him the Dragon Fighting Formation.
Meets Wang Lin's clone in the Cloud Sky Sect without recognising him.
Reunited with Wang Lin, who kills Sun Zhenwei for her.
Her lifespan is used up; Wang Lin keeps her Nascent Soul in a cold gorge.
Her Nascent Soul is placed in the newborn Zhou Ru.
Wakes inside Zhou Ru, refuses to take the girl's body, and says goodbye.

name: Li Qiqing
intro: Li Muwan's elder brother of the Luohe Sect; he first takes Wang Lin for a thief, then dies holding back fire beasts so she can escape.

name: Lu Song
intro: Heng Yue's top swordsman, beaten by Zhou Peng at the exchange contest.

name: Ouyang
intro: Xuan Dao Sect leader at the exchange contest, with a Thousand-legged Centipede.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Xuan Dao leader at the contest.

name: Zhou Peng
intro: Xuan Dao's eldest disciple, who beats Heng Yue's champions until Wang Lin defeats him.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Xuan Dao disciple at the contest.

name: Pu Nanzi
intro: Nascent Soul ancestor of the Xuan Dao Sect, called the strongest in Zhao, who takes Heng Yue Peak. Forced to serve the envoy Lin Yi, he protects Teng Huayuan, then burns his lifespan to hold the envoy back.

power.detail: arrives as a Nascent Soul cultivator

name: Bai Zhan
intro: Bandit chief and Ji Mo's disciple, Zhang Hu's master among the bandits; Wang Lin kills him.

name: Ji Mo
intro: Bai Zhan's master, whose revenge led the Teng clan to Wang Lin's family; centuries later he is a Teng guest elder and Wang Lin kills him.

name: Teng Huayuan
intro: Nascent Soul ancestor of the Teng clan. After Wang Lin kills his great-great-grandson he curses Wang Lin and massacres the Wang family, and four hundred years later Wang Lin comes back for him.

arc.text: Vows to kill Wang Lin after he takes Teng Li's foundation.
Wipes out the Wang family and seals Wang Lin's parents' souls in a Soul Flag.
Faces Wang Lin's return and the envoy's hundred-year deadline.
Uses the Reversal Formation, sacrificing his own clan, and admits why he killed the Wang family.
Dies at Wang Lin's hand.

name: Teng Li
intro: Spoiled Teng heir who hunts Wang Lin; Wang Lin kills him and seizes his foundation.

name: Adai
intro: Wu Yu's rebellious corpse puppet, which keeps its own mind; Ye Zizai keeps it for himself.

name: Wu Yu
intro: Corpse Yin Sect ancestor trapped as a Nascent Soul in a statue; he sends Wang Lin to the sect with a message for his junior brother.

name: Gao Qiming
intro: Nascent Soul cultivator of the Piao Miao Sect who helps Teng Huayuan find Wang Lin's home village for a turtle-shell treasure; he kills himself to atone, having saved one Wang bloodline.

name: Lin Yi
intro: Envoy of the Heavenly Tower who welcomes the Alliance envoys and launches a plan to rip out Zhao's spiritual roots, giving the Teng family a hundred years to produce a Soul Formation cultivator.

name: Ye Zizai
intro: Corpse Yin Sect ancestor who takes Wang Lin in as Wu Yu's disciple, but abandons Wu Yu and plans to sacrifice his disciples.

name: Ge Yang
intro: Xu Hao's partner, who stabs Ma Liang on the foreign battlefield.

name: Ma Liang
intro: War Shrine Sect disciple of the Fire Country, murdered on the foreign battlefield; Wang Lin makes a deal with him as he dies and takes his body.

name: Xu Hao
intro: Notorious killer who robs cultivators on the foreign battlefield.

name: Zhou Zihong
intro: Feng Luan's daughter and Ma Liang's senior sister, who knows Wang Lin is not the real Ma Liang; she gives him the last map in return for killing Xu Si and Zhou An.

name: Lin Tao
intro: Ma Liang's comrade, who serves Wang Lin because he holds his soul blood.

name: Xu Liguo
intro: A Tiangang Sect cultivator whose soul Wang Lin trains into his devil servant. He calls Wang Lin master and 'evil star', is paid in souls, schemes to escape, and later lives in Wang Lin's Rain Celestial Sword as its spirit.

power.detail: forms a core from swallowed souls after recovering to late Foundation Establishment

arc.text: Becomes Wang Lin's devil servant.
Bound into a Rain Celestial Sword as its spirit.
Taken by the Giant Demon Clan ancestor with the sword.
Betrays the Giant Demon ancestor and returns to Wang Lin.

name: Sun Youcai
intro: Thief of the Evil Demon Sect who tries to rob Wang Lin; Wang Lin learns the Earth Escape Technique from him.

name: Feng Luan
intro: Nascent Soul ancestor of the War Shrine Sect and Zhou Zihong's mother, who takes Wang Lin as a registered disciple and pays him with maps for kills in the war.

name: Qian Kun
intro: Great Elder of the Fighting Evil Sect, who flees Wang Lin and, before he dies, opens the Hundred-Day Kill Order on him; Wang Lin keeps his golden core.

power.detail: leads the sect's Core Formation elders

name: Mu Bei
intro: Mu Nan's brother, also a Fighting Evil Sect branch elder.

name: Mu Nan
intro: One of two brothers holding a Fighting Evil Sect branch, made to guide Wang Lin to the headquarters.

name: Shangguan Mo
intro: A bully of the outer Sea of Devils who calls himself the Black Devil; beaten by Wang Lin, he becomes his disciple and hands over his soul blood.

name: Xue Ming
intro: Former Great Elder of the Fighting Evil Sect who fled after infighting; he leads hunters against Wang Lin with the Ten Thousand Blood Demon Formation.

power.detail: his blood formation lifts its users to late Core Formation

name: Jie Donglai
intro: Leader of the Fighting Evil Sect, who fights Wang Lin with the Dragon Fighting Formation and dies.

power.detail: the formation lifts him to great perfection and a false Nascent Soul

name: Duanmu Ji
intro: A Soul Formation devil, one of the city lords of Seven Plum City, who hunts Wang Lin for three years to use his death spell in the Land of the Ancient God; killed by the puppet Hunchback Meng.

name: Six Desire Devil Lord
aka: Six Desire Devil Lord (六欲魔君)
intro: The Six Desire Devil Lord, one of the city lords of the inner Sea of Devils, who sways minds with desire and has studied restrictions for a thousand years; his master the Sky Devil Magician sacrifices him.

name: Hunchback Meng
intro: A Soul Formation poison cultivator with a thousand-year toad; he swallows its core to kill the Hurricane Beast King and dies, and Tuo Sen revives him as a mindless puppet that kills Duanmu Ji.

name: Tu Si
intro: An eight-star Ancient God whose body holds the trials of the Land of the Ancient God; he names Wang Lin the fourth Enlightened One and passes him his memories.

name: Sky Devil Magician
intro: Ancestor of the Xuan Tian Sect and Xu Liqing's master, thought dead for a thousand years; he raised Xu Liqing as a vessel and sacrifices him for the Ancient God's memory crystal.

name: Duomu
intro: One of eleven outside cultivators trapped by Tuo Sen; he poses as Tuo Sen's envoy while plotting against him and is killed by him.

name: Tuo Sen
intro: A shattered Ancient God sealed in the Land of the Ancient God, who revives the dead there as puppets and wants Wang Lin to free him. He secretly drives the Forsaken Immortal war on Planet Suzaku to reach the crystal, and descends as a monkey avatar.

looks.label: Monkey avatar
looks.desc: Descends as a giant monkey avatar strengthened by Ancient God blood.

name: Mo Yun
intro: Last disciple of the Qihuang Sect, fleeing the Poison Demon Palace with her sect's ancestral furnace; Wang Lin puts a restriction on her.

name: Qiu Siping
intro: A loose cultivator of the Sea of Devils who plots to devour his own master's and senior brother's Nascent Souls with Wang Lin's help.

power.detail: says he formed it after devouring a Nascent Soul

name: Cheng Ling
intro: Arrogant new Cloud Sky disciple and Sun Zhenwei's secret lover, who tricks Cheng Xian out of his spirit apes.

name: Song Qing
intro: Inner Sect master of the Cloud Sky Sect, who presides over the disciple selection and later helps run the sect for Wang Lin.

name: Sun Zhenwei
intro: Son of Sun Lingwu who forces a marriage on Li Muwan to take her Primordial Yin; Wang Lin kills him.

name: Zhou Lin
intro: Li Muwan's only disciple and the master of Wang Lin's clone in the Cloud Sky Sect; killed by Sun Zhenwei.

power.detail: late Core Formation in one subtitle, early in another

name: Cheng Xian
intro: Friendly Cloud Sky disciple with two spirit apes who befriends Wang Lin's clone.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Cloud Sky disciple with spirit apes.

name: Sun Lingwu
intro: Outer sect master of the Cloud Sky Sect and Sun Zhenwei's father, who covers for his son.

name: Lu Fei
intro: Cloud Sky outer elder guarding the Scripture Pavilion, held off by Wang Lin's restriction flag; later follows Wang Lin.

name: Ouyang Zi
intro: Master alchemist of the Cloud Sky Sect, who invents the pill-sacrifice technique and later refines the grade-six Origin Recovery Pill for Li Muwan.

name: Liu Fei
intro: Outer master of the Cloud Sky Sect who greets the wedding guests and later runs the sect for Wang Lin.

name: Mosquito Beast
intro: A coral-born mosquito beast Wang Lin subdues with illusions in the Sea of Devils; it grows by feeding on demons and metal jade and stays at his side.

name: Wu Cunsu
intro: Master of the Tian Dao Sect and a Teng family lackey; Wang Lin kills him in one move.

name: Teng Jiu
intro: Weakest of the Teng family's nine core members, killed in Wufeng Valley; Xu Liguo devours his soul.

name: Teng Er
intro: One of the Teng family's nine core members, waiting in Tianyin City; Wang Lin kills him and makes him a demon.

name: Teng San
intro: Teng core member who rallies Tianyin City's cultivators to hunt Wang Lin with the Meteor Sword; killed and turned into a demon.

name: Teng Xiu Xiu
intro: Teng daughter who loved Wang Zhuo at first sight and was married to him by the Teng ancestor for two hundred years; Wang Zhuo kills her to end the feud.

name: Teng Yi
intro: First of the Teng core members, cultivating in the Black Mire with a body made of stolen spiritual roots; Wang Lin kills him.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Teng core member in the Black Mire.

name: Na Duo
intro: Soul Transformation cultivator from Planet Five Elements who chases Wang Lin to recover a storage bag; he tells him a Cultivation Star Crystal can break the Extreme Realm bottleneck.

name: The old man
intro: A lecherous, gluttonous old man of immense cultivation in the capital of Nan, never named, who teaches Wang Lin about Intent Realms, lends him a straw hat and wants carvings of himself in return.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Lecherous old man of the capital.

name: Xu Tao
intro: Young master serving the crown prince of Nan, who buys Wang Lin's dragon carving and later begs him for help.

name: Zeng Daniu
intro: The blacksmith's son across the street who befriends 'Uncle Wang' during Wang Lin's mortal years, grows up and has a son; Wang Lin carries his family away from the killing snow.

name: Wen Baoxin
intro: Baiyun Sect elder who confronts the old man and shows a detachment Intent Realm.

name: Yi Fu
intro: Zhou Wutai's beloved disciple in the Baiyun Sect; Wang Lin destroys his natal Rakshasa and predicts his death within a century.

name: Zeng Xiaoniu
intro: Zeng Daniu's son, who wants to learn carving from 'Grandpa Wang'; an immortal takes him as a disciple.

name: Zhou Wutai
intro: Baiyun elder whose Intent Realm is to raise a disciple and kill him in grief; he becomes Wang Lin's rival-friend, gives him the Rain Cauldron, and later stands with him as one of Yun Quezi's candidates on Planet Suzaku.

name: All-Seer
intro: Tian Yunzi, founder of the Heavenly Fate Sect on Planet Tianyun, who pulls Wang Lin out of the cycle of reincarnation and takes him as the seventh Purple disciple. He seeks someone matching his Dao of Heavenly Fortune, and Du Jian later reveals he devoured his disciple Sun Yun.

arc.text: Pulls Wang Lin out of the cycle of reincarnation and invites him to Planet Tianyun.
Takes Wang Lin as the seventh Purple disciple of the Heavenly Fate Sect.
His grey-robed second soul passes Wang Lin the Celestial Slaughter Art.
Du Jian tells Wang Lin he saw All-Seer devour Sun Yun.

name: Hongdie
intro: Snow Region genius with the Five Spirits Body and an Emotionless Intent Realm, whose deal with the Suzaku Country drives the war on the Four Faction Alliance. She hunts Wang Lin, loses an arm and their duel, and Qian Feng absorbs her as his furnace Jue Qing.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Cold young prodigy of the Snow Region.

looks.label: One arm
looks.desc: Left with an empty sleeve after Wang Lin cuts off her arm.
looks.why: loses an arm to Wang Lin

looks.label: Furnace puppet
looks.desc: Ragged and half-mad, a furnace puppet of Qian Feng.

arc.text: The Heaven Defying Bead absorbs her earth spirit.
Loses an arm to Wang Lin in the Rain Celestial Realm.
Loses the duel to Wang Lin and is absorbed by Qian Feng as his furnace Jue Qing.
Leaves Wang Lin the Kunji Whip and Qian Feng's Intent before she dies.

name: Zhou Yun
intro: First guardian elder of the Heihun Sect, one of the Alliance's late Soul Formation masters, who leads the Nine Sons Killing Formation.

name: Sun Shuoyi
intro: Lord of the 72nd city of the New Snow Region; Wang Lin kills him and takes his identity and memories.

name: Mo Zhi
intro: A wandering cultivator with a Forgetting Intent Realm who helps Wang Lin understand his own; he turns out to be a Cultivation Alliance envoy who chooses Wang Lin for the crystal, seals Tuo Sen and settles Planet Suzaku.

name: Thunder Toad
intro: A top-grade spirit beast Wang Lin subdues with the Hunyuan Beast Control Ring, and keeps at his side.

name: Chi Hu
intro: Young leader of the Giant Demon Clan who leads Wang Lin into the Rain Celestial Realm's hidden fragment, gives him the Star Compass and swears to keep his secret; he later persuades Wang Lin to spare his clan.

name: Sun Tai
aka: First elder of the Shiyin Sect
intro: Grand Elder of the Corpse Yin Sect on Planet Suzaku who wants Zhou Yi's corpse, serves Wang Lin as a slave, then seals him to take his body. Exiled by the Giant Demon ancestor, he ends up a slave in Allheaven, helps Wang Lin there and dies in Moonfall Village.

power.detail: fallen while enslaved by the Lv clan in Allheaven

name: Zhan Bai
intro: An insect-cultivating demon-path cultivator from Planet Suzaku who entered the Rain Celestial Realm; he devours sects in Chu, attacks the Cloud Sky Sect and is killed by Wang Lin.

name: Zhou Yi
intro: The 'corpse lover' of Planet Suzaku, expelled from the Five Elements Sect, who carries the Celestial corpse Ting'er as his wife. He burns his soul to reach Ascendant, gives Wang Lin his pagoda and Sun Tai, becomes a Rain Celestial Sword spirit, and is freed again in the Demon Spirit Land.

power.detail: reached while burning his primordial soul

name: Sun Lei
intro: Third senior brother of a Da Luo Sword Sect team, really an infiltrator killing for treasure; he teams up with Wang Lin and self-detonates when outplayed.

name: Ting'er
intro: The corpse of a Celestial woman whom Zhou Yi treats as his wife; her remnant soul wakes, wields the Rain Celestial Swords against Ling Tianhou and dies thanking Zhou Yi.

name: Ling Tianhou
intro: The Sword Saint of the Da Luo Sword Sect on Planet Tianyun and master of its Twelve Sword disciples, who fights for the Rain Celestial Swords with his Scarlet Qilin and has fallen out with Tian Yunzi.

name: Tian Mozi
intro: A powerful outsider from Planet Tianmo who takes one of the four Rain Celestial Swords.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Outsider at the Rain Celestial Realm.

name: Gongsun Fan
intro: Old elder of the Piaomiao Sect protecting Zi Xin, who goes with her into the Land of the Forsaken Immortals.

name: Tie Yan
intro: A Cloud Sky Sect cultivator who follows Wang Lin and guards Zhou Ru while he is away.

name: Zi Xin
intro: Daughter of the Piaomiao Sect master who escaped being sold to the Suzaku Country as a furnace; she gives Wang Lin's main body a Reincarnation Fruit and meets him again at mid Soul Transformation.

name: Sun Dian
intro: Master of the Weapon Refining Pavilion whom Wang Lin knew two hundred years earlier; he joins the Reincarnation Tree trip and sacrifices his disciples' lifespans for the fruits.

name: Zhou Ru
intro: The girl Li Muwan's Nascent Soul is reborn into, born weak and mute in Xinghua Village; Wang Lin raises her from the age of five until Li Muwan wakes inside her.

looks.label: Child
looks.desc: Small girl, later ten, with a pet tiger Xiao Bai.
looks.why: grows up in Wang Lin's valley

name: Chi Mu
intro: Six-leaf war curse master of the Forsaken Immortal Clan, killed by Wang Lin with the God Slaying War Chariot.

name: Mu Ye
intro: Seven-leaf curse master of the Forsaken Immortal Clan who chases Wang Lin for months and plants a rune seed in him.

power.detail: seven-leaf curse master; seven leaves are said to equal Soul Transformation

name: Li Yuanfeng
intro: Master of the Snow Region with a Tea Intent Domain, who ambushes Wang Lin after the duel with Hongdie and seals his cultivation; Wang Lin kills him.

power.detail: falls to Nascent Soul after his defeat, just before he dies (EP89)

name: Liu Mei
intro: Zhu Quezi's second disciple, who walks the Thousand Illusions Emotionless Dao and is told Wang Lin is meant to be her furnace. In Allheaven she is adopted by the Huan clan as Huan Mei, refines Li'er from Wang Lin's blood, and is devoured by Huan Wuqing.

looks.label: Huan Mei
looks.desc: Appears as Huan Mei of the Huan clan.

arc.text: Learns from Zhu Quezi that Zeng Niu is Wang Lin and meant to be her furnace.
Driven out of the Soul Refining Sect by Dun Tian.
Flees Planet Suzaku beyond the stars.
Revealed as Huan Mei of the Huan clan in Allheaven.
Sees through Wang Lin's disguise and attacks him with illusions.
Her creature Li'er, refined from Wang Lin's blood soul, becomes his son Wang Ping.
Devoured by Huan Wuqing.

name: Qian Feng
intro: Zhu Quezi's first disciple and chosen heir, who absorbs Hongdie as his furnace and duels Wang Lin; Wang Lin kills him at the Suzaku Tomb.

name: Zhu Quezi
intro: The fourteenth Suzaku and ruler of Planet Suzaku, who treats talented cultivators as furnaces for his disciples. He stole the Cultivation Planet Heart from his master, wrecks the Soul Refining Sect for the Billion Soul Flag, and burns his lifespan in the war with the Forsaken Immortals.

power.detail: the only one on Planet Suzaku
after burning nine-tenths of his remaining lifespan for the Alliance

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: White-haired old man, much like Yun Quezi.

name: Yun Quezi
intro: Zhu Quezi's junior brother and old rival for the Suzaku title, who picks Wang Lin and Zhou Wutai among his candidates. He is secretly the Second Ancestor of the Forsaken Immortal Clan.

name: Giant Demon Clan ancestor
intro: Ancestor of the Giant Demon Clan, surnamed Wang, who ambushes Wang Lin for the Heaven Defying Bead and takes Xu Liguo; Wang Lin kills him.

name: Dun Tian
intro: The last ancestor of the Soul Refining Sect and keeper of the Billion Soul Flag, who makes Wang Lin his heir, guards his Soul Transformation, gives his lifespan to wake the flag's Fourth Main Soul against Zhu Quezi, and joins the flag.

power.detail: peak Soul Transformation; with the Billion Soul Flag he fights at mid Ascendant level (EP94)

name: Mei Ji
intro: A seductive soul fragment found in the Giant Demon ancestor's treasure, who is really the Third Ancestor of the Forsaken Immortal Clan, a nine-leaf curse shaman; her curse of desire is turned against Liu Mei.

name: Ancestor Xu
intro: First Ancestor of the Forsaken Immortal Clan, an eleven-leaf shaman whom Tuo Sen raised to twelve leaves and drove mad; he sacrifices himself to break the seal on his clan, and his skull opens the Suzaku Tomb.

name: Cui Zhi
intro: Fifth Ancestor of the Forsaken Immortal Clan, a nine-leaf shaman master who plants the Ancestor Soul Seed for the Reincarnation Trees.

name: Yun Yimo
intro: Former master of the Soul Refining Sect who took in the child Dun Tian, seen in Dun Tian's memories.

name: Cao Yidou
intro: A primordial soul of the Mi Le Sect from Planet Tianyun who came to buy a body; Wang Lin takes him as servant and guide for a hundred years.

name: Qian Pinghai
intro: The thirteenth Suzaku, master of Zhu Quezi and Yun Quezi; Zhu Quezi stole the Cultivation Planet Heart from him and sold his body to the Corpse Yin Sect.

name: Tuo Sen's puppet
intro: An Ascendant-level puppet of Tuo Sen posing as a late Soul Transformation stranger at the Suzaku Tomb; the crystal destroys it.

name: Ye Wuyou
intro: The first Suzaku, whose image inside the crystal offers Wang Lin the title.

name: Bai Wei
intro: Third disciple of the Heavenly Fate Sect's Purple Branch, who meets Wang Lin on the Trading Planet and explains the fight for the Purple title.

name: Zhao Xingsha
intro: Eldest Purple disciple of the Heavenly Fate Sect, who spent two thousand years chasing the title; he plots against Wang Lin and unleashes a Demon Spirit at the banquet.

name: Zhao Xinmeng
intro: Fourth Purple disciple, a woman who walks the Demon Shadow Dao; she traps Wang Lin to repay a debt to Zhao Xingsha, then gives him techniques.

name: Zhou Wan
intro: Second Purple disciple of the Heavenly Fate Sect, with an Immortal Demonic Body; Wang Lin kills him at the banquet.

name: Chi Lie
intro: Tian Yunzi's junior brother, who stops the fight at the birthday banquet.

name: Kunpeng Zi
intro: Heavenly Fate Sect disciple who takes the Yellow Branch title unopposed.

name: Sun Zhongan
intro: Cultivation Alliance envoy at Tian Yunzi's birthday, who confirms the Seven-Coloured Glazed Light.

name: Chen Tao
intro: Sixth Purple disciple of All-Seer, who returns and takes the Purple title from Wang Lin; later, wounded by the Da Luo Sword Sect, he hides his cultivation in the Demon Spirit Land and travels with Shi Xiao.

name: Lu Songyi
intro: Da Luo Sword Sect elder fighting over the golden fruits in Brilliant Golden Fruit Valley.

name: Qian Qin
intro: Suiyi Sect cultivator whose team the Da Luo elders wiped out; Wang Lin lets him go.

name: Sun Ruonan
intro: Sun Yunshan's sister, told by her father to keep an eye on Wang Lin.

name: Sun Yunshan
intro: Young master and deputy master of the Xuan Yuan Sect on Earthstar, who travels with Wang Lin to the East Sea.

name: Tan Lang
intro: An Alliance elder fallen from Illusory Yin who helped kill Situ Nan long ago. He leads the Da Luo Twelve Swords in the Tidal Abyss, sacrifices them to form the Tidal Token, then chases Wang Lin to Allheaven and is trapped inside the Moonwatcher.

power.detail: once helped besiege Situ Nan for the bead
fallen from Illusory Yin; in EP130 he claims to be held to late Ascendant

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Senior of the Da Luo Sword Sect.

name: Yao Xixue
intro: Daughter of the Blood Ancestor, who watches the East Sea tide and later serves as a commander in Ancient Demon City, looking for someone skilled in restrictions.

name: Ouyang Hua
intro: Chief of the mortal valley tribe that Wang Lin builds into the Soul Refining Tribe.

name: Shi San
intro: A youth of the valley tribe in the Demon Spirit Land, the first to make a Soul Flag; crippled by Tianshui men, he is given the Giant Demon body technique and serves Wang Lin.

name: Hu Pao
intro: A gifted boy of the Soul Refining Tribe whom Wang Lin takes as his personal disciple; he turns on Wang Lin to serve the Scattered Devil.

power.detail: a life-burning Time Spell pushes him to early Ascendant, then he drops back

name: Mo Lihai
intro: A Demon General of Ancient Demon City undefeated for a thousand years, master of the Ten Collapse Fist Conception, who makes Wang Lin a Commander.

name: Sima Yan
intro: Commander of the Black Armor Army, demoted to deputy when Wang Lin is given his post; he keeps working against him.

name: Ming Yuan
intro: The Scattered Devil's servant who rescued Hu Pao and taught him the life-burning Time Spell.

name: Scattered Devil
intro: An ancient devil spirit at the Demon Tower on the Ancient Battlefield, one of nine Scattered Devils, which feeds on new Ascendants' primordial qi; it is finally sealed inside Wang Lin's divine soul.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Spirit inside a black demon armor.

looks.label: Flesh body
looks.desc: Leaves its armor for a flesh body whose face resembles Ling Tianhou.

name: Shi Xiao
intro: Border Demon General and Mo Lihai's long-time rival, skilled in the Six Finger Sword Technique, who kills assistants in the tournament.

name: Xu Huichuan
intro: Head of Hong Prison, who lets Wang Lin slaughter prisoners and leads him to the Slaughter Blood Pool in return for killing a Demon General.

name: Emperor Sword Spirit
intro: The spirit of the Demon Emperor's Emperor Sword, a spoiled girl nurtured in the Slaughter Blood Pool.

name: Mo Fei
intro: Top-ranked Demon General, the 'God of Slaughter' of the border, who sends assassins after Wang Lin and beats Mo Lihai; Wang Lin later captures him.

name: Wei Yang
intro: Da Luo Twelve Swords disciple with a goat soul who serves Mo Fei; he attacks Wang Lin and loses Ling Tianhou's sword qi to him.

name: Gu Yunchi
intro: Demon Emperor of Sky Demon Country and grandson of its Second Ancestor, who later gives Wang Lin a jade slip carrying his authority.

name: Vice Commander-in-Chief Xuan
intro: Favourite of the Demon Emperor about to become Commander-in-Chief, who backs Wang Lin to win the tournament.

name: Jin Wuxu
intro: Eunuch steward of Sky Demon City who runs the tournament and bets against Wang Lin at the drum.

name: Vice Commander-in-Chief Huang
intro: Vice Commander-in-Chief of Sky Demon Country who bets against Wang Lin.

name: Bei Lou
intro: An Ancient Demon remnant soul in the Demonic Battle Drum and ancestor of Sky Demon Country, who saves Wang Lin from Heaven's Wrath, makes him Heavenly Demon Envoy and devours the Fire Demon with his help.

name: Blood Ancestor
intro: Yao Xixue's father, ruler of the Blood clan, who plans to claim Qin Lin's abode; Wang Lin later carries a treasure made from half of his blood body.

name: Huang Yu
intro: A Lianyu Sect cultivator posing as the Alliance's Immortal Ancestor with treasures from an Immortal Realm cave abode; Wang Lin beats and captures him.

name: Fire Demon
intro: An Ancient Demon fragment ruling Fire Demon Country, devoured by Bei Lou.

name: Chen Long
intro: Eldest of the Da Luo disciples trapped in the Tidal Abyss, who pushes Tan Lang to break out.

name: Du Jian
intro: A Red Division disciple of the Heavenly Fate Sect who fears Wang Lin's rise and lures him into a trap. Trapped with him in the abyss, he reveals that All-Seer devoured Sun Yun, and Wang Lin forges him into his Immortal Guard for a thousand years.

power.detail: reaches Ascendant before he is forged

looks.label: Immortal Guard
looks.desc: Forged into Wang Lin's Immortal Guard puppet.

name: Hu Juan
intro: Wang Wei's wife, a Nirvana Shatterer, who later helps the elders send a pursuer after Wang Lin across the star boundary.

name: Wang Wei
intro: A Nirvana Shatterer of the Celestial Cloud couple in the Demon Spirit Land, Hu Juan's husband, who tracks Tan Lang and the Tidal Token.

name: Sun Yun
intro: A former prodigy of the Heavenly Fate Sect who held the Purple title and the Ziyun Pavilion; said to have betrayed the sect, he was in fact devoured by All-Seer.

name: Ran Xuefeng
intro: One of the three Ascendant ancestors of Planet Ran Yun, who helped kill a Huan clansman; he dies to Huan Mei's illusions while his avatar flees.

name: Sun Ling
intro: A young Sun family member guarding a spirit-vein residence, who lectures 'Xu Mu' on hard work and tries to protect him.

name: Sun Xi
intro: Sun family ancestor of Planet Ran Yun who schemed to make Wang Lin his scapegoat; Wang Lin saves his avatar and restores him to Soul Transformation.

power.detail: restored by Wang Lin after losing his Ascendant body, and can no longer advance; his hidden avatar was at late Core Formation

name: Zhao Chuanwen
intro: A rogue Ascendant cultivator, third of the Ran Yun ancestors in the Huan killing.

name: Huan Dong
intro: Huan Mei's guard, sent to wipe out Planet Ran Yun; killed by Wang Lin.

name: Huan Fengshen
intro: Head of the Huan clan, who stays out of the feud and later hands over the clan's Celestial Ascension Fruits.

name: Huan Wuqing
intro: The twenty-sixth-generation Huan ancestor who adopted Liu Mei as Huan Mei to take her domain, devoured her, and was devoured by the Scattered Devil.

name: Sun Qiming
intro: First Elder and later clan master of the Sun family, who pays Wang Lin off and later orders the clan to keep away from him.

name: Qian Kuizi
intro: Wily third ancestor of the Qian clan on Planet Thousand Illusion, who tries to take Wang Lin's puppet, then bows to him as a Thunder envoy.

name: Wang Ping
intro: Born as Li'er, a creature Liu Mei refined from Wang Lin's blood soul; Wang Lin renames him and raises him as a mortal son. He founds the Tianxing Empire and fades away at about seventy, with Qing Yi beside him.

looks.label: First appearance
looks.desc: Creature refined from Wang Lin's blood soul.

name: Qing Yi
intro: A young Sun family member who warns Wang Ping, is expelled for it, and spends her life as his wife; she chooses to die with him.

name: Lei Daozi
intro: Envoy of the Thunder Celestial Temple hunting the fake envoy; Wang Lin beats him and forges his body into a second Immortal Guard.

name: Shengong Hu
intro: Young genius of the Southern Domain, one of the Three Heroes of the South and a Thunder Celestial Temple envoy; a glance from Wang Lin drops his cultivation, and he gives Wang Lin his Dao soul and serves him as master.

name: Zhan Konglie
intro: Corporeal Yang envoy of the Thunder Celestial Temple from the Zhan family, Shengong Hu's rival, who backs down and respects Wang Lin after seeing his insight.

name: Zhang Zhen
intro: Founding ancestor of the Zhang family, newly at Illusory Yin, who gives Wang Lin a Thunder Cauldron and trades him the Third Eye divine art.

name: Tang Yanfeng
intro: Corporeal Yang genius of the Tang family, one of the Three Heroes of the South, who mocks Shengong Hu.

name: Xu Fenghan
intro: Illusory Yin cultivator of the Xu family who tries to rob Wang Lin of origin energy and dies.

name: Yan Leizi
intro: A Nirvana Shatterer who spends ages planning to refine the Thunder Celestial Realm into a treasure and vows to crush the Alliance; he lures Qing Shui in and wins him over.

name: Ge Hong
intro: Young lady of the Ge family who feeds cultivators to her family's Heavenly Ghost and holds Li Yuan's life soul.

name: Li Yuan
intro: Last heir of a restriction-art family of Annihilation Star cursed by a slave mark; a restriction genius who becomes Wang Lin's (Xu Mu's) close friend and partner in the Thunder Celestial Realm.

name: Gu Ziyuan
intro: An Immortal King and general of the old Thunder Celestial Realm who died in its fall; his sword spirit cursed the Li family to revive him, but he chooses not to come back.

power.detail: a general of the Celestial Realm and Immortal King

name: Yao Luo
intro: A Yao family descendant who hunts Li Yuan for thirteen days; killed by Wang Lin.

name: Qing Shui
intro: Crown Prince of Qing Shui Country and Bai Fan's disciple, an Immortal Lord who went mad, lost Han Yan and sealed himself. He wakes as a white-haired old man with no memory, fights Wang Lin, and joins Yan Leizi.

power.detail: peak Nirvana Shatterer in his prime

looks.label: White-haired old man
looks.desc: Breaks out of a sealed formation as a white-haired old man.

name: Bai Fan
intro: Immortal Emperor of the Thunder Celestial Realm, who created Call Wind and died mysteriously after sealing Qing Shui.

name: Celestial King Carefree
intro: Xiaoyao Zi, a ninth-grade Immortal King who painted the Collection Pavilion's painting, owned the Wither Dao Pair and ordered the Chosen Immortal Clan to guard the Xuanyin Tripod.

name: Ta Shan
intro: The clan head's grandson and altar guardian of the Chosen Immortal Clan, who resents the immortals and asks Wang Lin to lead the clan out.

name: Zu Zhang
intro: Old head of the Chosen Immortal Clan, who holds to the immortals' order to guard the Xuanyin Tripod.
